channel.title: Jesús Rubio — Late Edition
channel.description: Posts from Jesús Rubio's rainy-room website.

item.title: How this room was built
item.description: Blender, Python, Cycles lightmaps, synthesised sound and a lot of shaders: the making of this website.

item.title: Microsoft AI Tour: AI at scale
item.description: Session announcement for the Microsoft AI Tour on 26 February, together with Omar Mokrani Gallego: what it takes to run AI at scale on Azure.

item.title: A 3D RPG that talks back
item.description: GitHub Copilot custom agents, Unity MCP, Microsoft Foundry, Bing and Fabric, all in one little game. The characters answer questions about their world, the news and real data.

item.title: A desktop agent in two hours
item.description: The Copilot SDK came out and I wondered whether a regular developer could build a desktop agent with it. Less than two hours later it was public on GitHub.

item.title: AI in health: past and future
item.description: Opening talk of a course on artificial intelligence for nurses at the Colegio de Enfermería de Burgos: evidence-based care, writing, images, video and data.

item.title: Maple Leaf, an AI short film
item.description: An original story turned into a short film with generative video, voice and music during 2024. The credits for every tool roll at the end.

item.title: Speaking at OGECON
item.description: On stage in Burgos with FAE Burgos, Ibercaja and the University of Burgos, in front of 75 local companies, talking about how AI is changing every layer of work.
